E.R.R.S.E.L.A.
ETIC Research Robot for
Student Engagement & Learning Activities

E.R.R.S.E.L.A. TM  is a collaborative research and student engagement program created by New York Institute of Technology at the College of Engineering & Computing Sciences . The program was originated at the Entrepreneurship & Technology Innovation Center (ETIC)  and enables students from multiple disciplines, and with varied skill levels, to collaborate and participate in the robot's design and functionality. Students from New York Tech as well as students from various middle schools, high schools and other regional two and four year colleges, can all participate in the design project to gain real world experience in various areas of engineering and computer science.
